---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(lubridate)

mallards <- read_csv("data/mallards.csv") |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = ymd_hms(timestamp, tz = "UTC"),
    month = factor(month(timestamp, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE), levels = month.name),
    month_num = month(timestamp),
    year = year(timestamp),
    season = case_when(
      month_num %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
      month_num %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
      month_num %in% 9:11 ~ "Autumn",
      TRUE ~ "Winter"
    ),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter"))
  )

saveRDS(mallards, "data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7.5

countries <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

mallards |>
  filter(between(lat, 47, 55), between(long, 8, 25)) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = countries, fill = "grey96", color = "grey65", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = long, y = lat, color = duck_id),
    alpha = 0.55,
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(8, 25), ylim = c(47, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo", guide = guide_legend(ncol = 4)) +
  labs(
    title = "Where Do Mallards Go?",
    subtitle = "GPS locations of 52 Mallards tracked from Lake Constance",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    color = "Duck ID"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
